issues.legal_issue: Contractual deadlines for payment and vacant possession must be read together where the possession clause qualifies the payment clause, and time was not of the essence in the agreement.

A purchaser seeking specific performance must continuously demonstrate readiness and willingness, including the financial capacity to pay the balance, and the purchaser’s conduct and failure to act despite opportunities may defeat that claim.
A vendee seeking specific performance after unilateral cancellation of an agreement must seek a declaration that the cancellation is invalid and not binding.
A suit cannot be dismissed as unmaintainable at the appellate stage merely because declaratory relief was not sought if maintainability was not an issue before the trial court.

A higher court may examine whether a jurisdictional fact necessary for granting relief existed even if the trial court did not frame an issue on it, provided that no new facts or evidence are required.
